executive_summary: The Maven build failed during test compilation with 90 errors. The primary issues are type incompatibilities where TaskStatus and TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String, missing methods in DTO classes (setVersion, setPage, setLast, getSuccessCount, etc.), method signature mismatches in TaskService.getUserTasks(), and ErrorResponse type conflicts between packages. These errors indicate a mismatch between test code expectations and actual implementation after recent code changes.

errors.message: Multiple type incompatibility errors: TaskStatus and TaskPriority enums cannot be converted to String (40+ occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code is attempting to pass TaskStatus and TaskPriority enum values where String parameters are expected. This suggests the DTO or entity classes were recently changed to use enums instead of Strings, but test code was not updated accordingly.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test files to use .name() or .toString() when passing enum values to methods expecting Strings. Example: change TaskStatus.OPEN to TaskStatus.OPEN.name(). Alternatively, update the DTOs to accept enum types directly instead of Strings.

errors.message: Missing methods in DTO classes: setVersion(), setPage(), setLast(), setSuccessCount(), setFailureCount(), setErrors(), getPage(), getLast(), getSuccessCount(), getFailureCount(), getErrors()
errors.root_cause: The DTO classes (TaskResponse, PagedTaskResponse, BulkTaskResponse) are missing setter and getter methods that test code expects. This indicates DTOs were refactored to use immutable patterns or builder patterns without updating tests.
errors.fix_recommendation: Either add the missing setter/getter methods to the DTO classes, or refactor test code to use builder patterns or constructors to create DTO instances. If using Lombok, ensure @Data or @Setter/@Getter annotations are present on the DTO classes.

errors.message: Method getUserTasks signature mismatch: required (Long, Pageable) but found (Long, int, int, String)
errors.root_cause: The TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature was changed to accept a Pageable object instead of individual pagination parameters (page, size, sort). Test code still uses the old signature with separate parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test method calls to TaskService.getUserTasks() to use PageRequest.of(page, size, Sort.by(sortField)) instead of passing individual parameters. Import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest and org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.

errors.message: Type mismatch: ResponseEntity<com.myproject.exceptions.ErrorResponse> cannot be converted to ResponseEntity<com.myproject.models.dtos.ErrorResponse> (12 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: There are two ErrorResponse classes in different packages (com.myproject.exceptions and com.myproject.models.dtos). The GlobalExceptionHandler returns one type but tests expect the other, indicating a package refactoring issue.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate ErrorResponse into a single class in one package (preferably com.myproject.models.dtos). Update GlobalExceptionHandler to use the correct ErrorResponse class and remove the duplicate class from com.myproject.exceptions package.

errors.message: Missing exception handler methods: handleConcurrentCreation() and handlePerformanceThreshold()
errors.root_cause: Test code expects GlobalExceptionHandler to have methods for handling ConcurrentTaskCreationException and PerformanceThresholdExceededException, but these methods do not exist in the handler class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Either add the missing exception handler methods to GlobalExceptionHandler class with @ExceptionHandler annotations, or remove the corresponding test methods if these exception types are no longer used.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: class BulkTaskError in BulkTaskResponse
errors.root_cause: The BulkTaskResponse class is missing an inner class or separate class called BulkTaskError that test code expects to exist for representing individual bulk operation errors.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add a BulkTaskError class (either as an inner class in BulkTaskResponse or as a separate DTO) with fields for taskId and error message. Update BulkTaskResponse to include a List<BulkTaskError> field for tracking individual failures.

summary: 6 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 90+ individual error instances
